integrity_notes: The four-color existence result in Cranston (2018) is explicitly credited; numerical classification has two executable exhaustive implementations and explicit class/orbit and smaller-palette witness tables. No claim of independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite classification for the fourteen-vertex Heawood graph only. A full third-party independent audit and an exhaustive historical priority census have not been performed. The general chromatic polynomial is not by itself a distinguishing-coloring enumerator.
title: Fifty-one symmetry types of optimal proper distinguishing colorings of the Heawood graph
